title: privacy.erased (v1) data payload
description: A per-service acknowledgement that a service has erased or anonymized its local slice for a userId. Published by EVERY service to its OWN '<service>.events' exchange with routing key 'privacy.erased'; consumed by the Control Room to track erasure completion. (ADR-0009.)

userId.description: The erased userId (now a tombstone in the emitting service).

service.description: The emitting service name (matches the envelope 'source').

mode.description: deleted = local slice removed; anonymized = retained record stripped of PII (Billing, under legal retention).

at.description: When this service completed erasure (RFC3339 UTC).
